note: Golden hashes of the canonical marking rule set serialization. A change here means a scoring-semantics change and must be reviewed as one. `jeeMain`/`jeeAdvanced` are the ASSESSMENT-ENGINE §2.4 reference sets, each ALWAYS-terminated per F46 with a neutral terminal award; `jeeMain2026Profile` is the set the shipped JEE Main 2026 profile carries, which also covers NUMERIC items. The NEET UG 2026 profile carries the `jeeMain` set exactly and therefore shares its hash.
